title: BACKND Base push notifications
summary: Device push registration from the client: register a device token to turn push ON (PutDeviceToken), turn push OFF, and opt in/out of night push, with separate Android and iOS flows. Console-side push setup is required for actual delivery.
capabilities: route push enable/disable and night-push questions to the right platform flow
explain that push defaults to night-push opt-out
separate Android and iOS device-token handling
prerequisites: Console push configuration is complete for the target platform
A valid device token is available from the platform
SDK is initialized and the user is logged in
common_pitfalls: Expecting push delivery without console-side push setup
Reusing Android flow assumptions on iOS (and vice versa)
Forgetting night-push is opt-out by default
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the platform source route before generating push code.
Verify console push setup separately from SDK calls.
public_notes: Client registers the device token; actual push requires console configuration.
Android and iOS flows differ; verify per platform.
